plan_title: SSPLAN-708 Test Plan — Add Goal & legend to rolling index charts

results.test: Primary Add Goal & legend to rolling index charts  render path
results.steps: Open target route with valid fixture/user context.
results.assertion: Expected primary content appears with correct title/value labels and no console/runtime error.
results.evidence: No live server was available in this run. To verify manually, open `/`, `/hfb/:id`, and `/hfb/:hfbId/pa/:paId` from frontend/src/App.tsx:33-36 and confirm the rolling index chart renders the goal/LY legend and chart content correctly. results.test: Interaction path for Add Goal & legend to rolling index charts
results.assertion: State transition completes within 1 click/gesture and target view/data updates correctly.
results.evidence: No live server was available in this run. To verify manually, open the rolling index routes from frontend/src/App.tsx:33-36 and confirm interacting with the surrounding page keeps rolling index content aligned with the selected entity. results.steps: Return empty dataset or no eligible rows.
results.assertion: Fallback/empty message is shown and layout remains stable (no broken placeholders).
results.evidence: The chart has an explicit empty state (`No data available`) when no rolling points exist (frontend/src/features/entity-detail/RollingIndexChart.tsx:57-124).

results.assertion: Error state is user-visible, recoverable on retry, and does not hard-crash route.
results.evidence: The callers fall back when rolling metric fetches fail (frontend/src/features/entity-detail/HFBDetailPage.tsx:81-107,139,171-184,207; frontend/src/features/entity-detail/PADetailPage.tsx:67-82,118,152-161,171-173), but `RollingIndexChart` itself does not show a retry/error state for API failures.

results.steps: Run representative fixture values through transform/mapping layer.
results.assertion: Scaled and raw fields retain expected precision (sales scaled where applicable, index untouched).
results.evidence: The chart renders the planned goal/LY encodings in source: a goal reference line, `vsLastYear` bars, `vsGoal` line, and value labels are all present (frontend/src/features/entity-detail/RollingIndexChart.tsx:57-124).

results.steps: Feed out-of-order and duplicate-key fixture records.
results.assertion: Output order and uniqueness follow deterministic rule (documented sort/dedupe behavior).
results.evidence: Rolling points are emitted in a deterministic YTD/13w/8w/4w/1w order by `buildRollingIndex` using fixed window labels (backend/src/main/java/com/ikea/sp/service/impl/H2PerformanceService.java:55-62,71-101).

results.steps: Inspect generated request payload and query params for this feature path.
results.assertion: Metric/level/filters are populated exactly as expected for selected hierarchy context.
results.evidence: The plan expects a `/metrics` POST rolling-trend contract, but this backend project only exposes `/api` GET routes (backend/src/main/java/com/ikea/sp/controller/DashboardController.java:14,29-145); the FE metric calls point to an external metrics host instead (frontend/src/services/metricsApi.ts:12-14,172-215,244-257,289-297).
results.failure_reason: Rolling index /metrics backend contract absent in project

results.steps: Compare required FE keys against backend response schema fixture.

results.evidence: There is no explicit schema drift guard for rolling-index responses; source only defines type shapes and render logic (frontend/src/services/metricsApi.ts:12-14,172-215,244-257,289-297; frontend/src/features/entity-detail/RollingIndexChart.tsx:57-124).
results.failure_reason: No rolling index schema drift guard
